summary_notes: Key catalyst: converting US$22.4B backlog into profitable, scalable deployments while managing deployment timing and next-gen storage transition risks. Q2 FY2026 (reported ~May 6, 2026): revenue $676.48M (+23% YoY), net income $9M, swung from loss a year ago to positive EPS; beat revenue estimates 4 quarters running. Q3 2026 guidance $700M-$720M. Risks: execution on next-gen transition, high customer concentration. Tech momentum: APD, SyMicro, Nyobolt batteries, BreakPack upgrades, Fox acquisition. Recent insider share sales noted as a sentiment overhang.
